correctness.rationale: Ordered products of the generating exponentials give integral coordinates for the lattice: reordering introduces only integer central commutators. The signed graph action preserves its generators. Equivariant rational Nomizu applies; negating central dual generators yields the stated CE convention. An independent tuple-wedge/Fraction replay exhausts all 1,024 basis monomials, checks d²=0 and both action identities and relations, and verifies the full differential ranks (0,5,20,59,81,81,59,20,5,0) and subgroup-invariant complexes. The rotation-fixed cohomology has dimension q=a+b, the reflection trace is 2u−β=a−b, and β−q=4c. The fixed space of the rotation splits into the two rational reflection signs; on its complement r makes the space a Q(ζ₅)-module, on which s is conjugate-semilinear. Taking a basis of the fixed space over the real subfield gives copies of W (multiplying by a nonzero anti-invariant scalar exchanges the two s-eigenspaces). Thus the reconstruction is complete, not just a dimension check. All eleven multiplicity triples and total 364 agree. Equivariant triangulation and rational averaging identify cohomology of the ordinary quotients with their invariants, and both quotient vectors agree with direct orbit-sum calculations. Reflection reverses the orientation because its vertex determinant is +1 and its unique fixed edge is reversed; rotations preserve orientation.
residual_risks: The result is for this rational graded module and the stated geometric quotients; no claim about integral cohomology, cup products or other cycle lengths was tested.

value.rationale: The pentagon is a natural cyclic graph beyond the path and star full formulas. The symmetry-resolved invariant is mathematically useful for the ordinary geometric quotients, which do not require a free action: for example, rotation-fixed b₈=4 drops to 2 under the whole group, and top cohomology vanishes only for the latter. The complete module separates orientation effects from degree-by-degree rotation and reflection invariants, and gives an exact benchmark for equivariant graph cohomology. Its value is not just attaining the existing numerical lower bound.
residual_risks: The finding is a finite symmetry computation; it does not imply any all-cycle family formula.
